evals.query: Rewrite this MCP tool description for the webular scrape tool: "A powerful, seamless solution that leverages cutting-edge technology to unlock all of your web content needs." Keep the tool name and the `archive` field exact.

Write the CLI help text for `webular map`. It lists the pages on one site from its sitemap, then robots.txt, then link crawling. It takes --url and --limit (default 50). Make it clear for a person who reads it once.

Write the state and question text for a Jev payload that asks whether a scraped page states the price of the 2026 model. Keep the JSON keys and the yes/no enum values exact, and put every decisive fact in the state.
Rewrite the description of the `limit` field in the search tool schema, which says "Allows the caller to optionally specify a desired quantity of results". The default is 5 and the most is 20.
A crawl read 40 of 120 pages before it hit the time limit. Write the status line for the user. Do not say it is done, and do not invent a cause.
Tidy this error text but keep the quoted string exact: Failed to fetch "https://example.com/a?b=1": ECONNRESET. Add a plain next step.
